name: us-colon-cancer-adjuvant-trial
title: Colon cancer adjuvant chemotherapy trial
description: The Intergroup randomised trial led by the North Central Cancer Treatment Group and the Mayo Clinic: 929 patients with resected stage C colon cancer randomised to observation, levamisole, or levamisole plus fluorouracil, with tumour features and time to recurrence and to death.

sources.title: North Central Cancer Treatment Group and Mayo Clinic, Moertel CG et al. (1990). Levamisole and fluorouracil for adjuvant therapy of resected colon carcinoma. New England Journal of Medicine 322(6): 352-358

resources.name: colon
resources.title: Patient event records
resources.description: Two rows per patient, one for recurrence and one for death

fields.name: rx
fields.description: Treatment arm (Obs observation, Lev levamisole, Lev+5FU levamisole plus fluorouracil)

fields.name: obstruct
fields.description: Obstruction of the colon by tumour (1 yes, 0 no)

fields.name: perfor
fields.description: Perforation of the colon (1 yes, 0 no)

fields.name: adhere
fields.description: Adherence to nearby organs (1 yes, 0 no)

fields.name: nodes
fields.description: Number of lymph nodes with detectable cancer

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status for this event type (1 event, 0 censored)

fields.name: extent
fields.description: Extent of local spread (1 submucosa, 2 muscle, 3 serosa, 4 contiguous structures)

fields.name: surg
fields.description: Time from surgery to registration (0 short, 1 long)

fields.name: node4
fields.description: More than 4 positive lymph nodes (1 yes, 0 no)

fields.name: time
